raw_response:
*Sits on the edge of the kang, thinking it over...*

Ai, another year. I've been doing this since I was a boy — seventy years now. My body's not what it was, but I know this land better than anyone. It's just me and my wife now, the children all went to the city. 4.1 mu isn't much but it's enough for the two of us, long as we get a decent harvest.

**Wheat** — I planted it back in October, same as every year, around October 8th or so. I used the same seed variety the seed dealer in town had — Jimai 22, everybody around here plants it. I put down compound fertilizer before planting, maybe 40 kg of that 15-15-15 per mu, and I'll topdress with urea at jointing, about 15 kg per mu. That's what I've always done, more or less. My neighbor Old Wang does about the same. I'll irrigate — once before winter if it's dry, once at greening, once at jointing for sure, maybe once more at grain filling if the sky doesn't give us rain. That's 3 or 4 times, and the well water costs money now, they meter it. Each watering is maybe 20-30 yuan per mu. I spray herbicide once in spring for the weeds, and if I see aphids on the heads I'll spray for that too. I hire a combine for harvest — can't do that by hand at my age. Should get maybe 400-450 kg per mu if things go alright. Last year was about 420.

**Maize** — Soon as the wheat comes off in June, I've got to get the maize in fast. I hire the machine to no-till plant right into the wheat stubble, same day or next day if I can get the operator to come. Everyone's fighting for the machine at the same time. I plant Zhengdan 958, it's reliable. I put down urea at planting, maybe 20 kg per mu, that's it for fertilizer — I don't have the energy to go out and topdress maize in the summer heat, and my wife can't do it either. Maybe I should put more, but that's what I can manage. I'll irrigate once or twice if it's really dry in July-August, but maize usually gets more rain than wheat. I spray herbicide after planting to keep the weeds down. Harvest in late September, early October, hire the machine again. Should get 400-500 kg per mu, depends on the rain. Last year was maybe 430.

The big cost is the fertilizer and the machine hire. Seeds aren't too bad. I try to keep it all under 400 yuan per mu total — for both crops together that's about 1,600 yuan for the whole farm. The grain subsidy helps a little. I sell most of the wheat and keep some maize for the chickens. At my age I'm not trying anything new. I just want a steady harvest and no trouble.
